svg.metadata: Target administrative geometry: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural vectors, WGS84, public domain, via LonnyGomes/CountryGeoJSONCollection (VEN.geojson); surrounding coastline context: GSHHS/GSHHG via Basemap intermediate resolution. Natural Earth de facto boundary depiction is used without taking a position on territorial claims. Cayo de Agua is below national-canvas coastline resolution and is represented by a verified-location island symbol. Checked 2026-09-26.
